name: United Kingdom (England & Wales)
convention: GOV.UK official bank holidays for England & Wales. Unlike the Nordic calendars, the substitute day IS the bank holiday: when a holiday falls on a weekend, GOV.UK lists the substitute weekday and this fixture lists exactly the GOV.UK dates. This is the nextWorkingDay observance chain from spec §1.1: Christmas 2027 (Sat) substitutes to Mon 12-27, and Boxing Day 2027 (Sun) would also take Monday but finds it occupied and takes Tue 12-28. Good Friday and Easter Monday are holidays; Holy Saturday is NOT (v1's GB entry wrongly had it — confirms spec §1.5), and the early May bank holiday v1 was missing is present.
sources: https://www.gov.uk/bank-holidays.json (machine-readable; 2027 substitutes taken from this feed directly)
notes: 2026-12-28 is the Boxing Day substitute (nominal 12-26 is a Saturday; Christmas Day 12-25 is a Friday and needs none).

2027-12-27 (Christmas substitute) + 2027-12-28 (Boxing Day substitute) is the two-link collision chain — the exact worked example behind the nextWorkingDay observance rule; make it a required resolver test.
Early May (first Monday of May), spring (last Monday of May) and summer (last Monday of August) holidays exercise nthWeekday and lastWeekday.
Scotland and Northern Ireland differ (Jan 2, St Andrew's Day; St Patrick's Day, July 12); out of scope unless a calendar id for them is added.
